llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed tutoring report assistant that reads one selected student's learning records to draft reports and does not include code, sending, or broad data access.

dimensions.detail: The package is explicitly scoped to Mainland China Chinese K12 tutoring conventions and includes cautions to localize crisis channels, curriculum, consent, and regulatory assumptions for other regions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains Markdown and JSON guidance/templates only; inspection found no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, shell commands, or tool wrapping.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions repeatedly require a student alias before reading records, prohibit cross-student scans and fabricated statistics, require authorization before parent-visible output, and state that teachers manually send any generated text.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill may write only confirmed stage evidence to workspace.progressEvidence and allows deletion of its own stage-evidence records after confirmation; it expressly avoids changing student cards, course ledgers, authorization fields, sending messages, or deleting full student files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill reads sensitive minor learning records, course-package data, consent fields, and prior parent-communication summaries to produce stage and renewal reports; that access is directly tied to its stated reporting purpose and is limited to one named student.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with a reporting skill reading a selected student's learning history and consent fields to draft teacher-reviewed reports. For use outside Mainland China, localize legal, crisis-support, curriculum, and consent assumptions before using it with students or parents.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The off-campus-training reference is Chinese and Mainland-China-specific because the skill package is expressly for Chinese K12 tutoring compliance; this is disclosed scope rather than hidden behavior or expanded authority.
[SQP-3] expected: The platform conventions state the Mainland China default and require localization of help channels, curriculum, and consent rules before use elsewhere, so the locale default is visible to operators.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The SARIF scan reported no results, and local inspection found only Markdown/JSON artifacts with no executable or remote-execution mechanism.
